data.name: NoDesignerBlock
data.value: The file has no Begin block, so it holds no form.

data.name: NotAUserForm
data.value: {0} is not a VBA UserForm's designer, so the file holds no form the reader imports.
data.comment: {0} is the class the root block names.

data.name: NamelessForm
data.value: The file's Begin line names no form, so it holds no form the reader imports.

data.name: MalformedLine
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based line of the file; {1} is what is wrong with it.

data.name: MissingCompanionNotCited
data.value: {0} cites no designer data, so it is imported with no controls.

data.name: MissingCompanion
data.value: The designer data of {0}, in {1}, was not found, so it is imported with no controls.
data.comment: {0} is the form's name; {1} is the companion file's name.

data.name: UnreadableDesignerData
data.value: The designer data of {0} cannot be read ({1}), so it is imported with no controls.
data.comment: {0} is the form's name; {1} is why.

data.name: UnmodelledClass
data.value: {0} is left out, with the {2} controls it holds: RDForms has no class for {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the control's name; {1} is its MSForms class; {2} is how many controls it holds.

data.name: UnmodelledClassEmpty
data.value: {0} is left out: RDForms has no class for {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the control's name; {1} is its MSForms class.

data.name: InvalidValue
data.value: The {1} of {0}, {2}, is not a value RDForms can hold, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the component's name; {1} is the property's name; {2} is its value.

data.name: ValueNotPorted
data.value: The {1} of {0}, {2}, has no equivalent in RDForms, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the component's name; {1} is the property's name; {2} is its value.

data.name: NotImplemented
data.value: The {1} of {0} is {2}, which RDForms does not implement, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the component's name; {1} is the property's name; {2} is its value.

data.name: MetafilePicture
data.value: The {1} of {0} is a metafile: it is kept, and RDForms does not draw it.
data.comment: {0} is the component's name; {1} is the property's name.

data.name: AcceleratorNotInCaption
data.value: The Accelerator of {0}, {1}, is not in its caption, so the caption has no access key.
data.comment: {0} is the control's name; {1} is the key.

data.name: UnresolvedDataSource
data.value: The {1} of {0} is kept as text. {2}
data.comment: {0} is the control's name; {1} is ControlSource or RowSource; {2} is the port diagnostic's message.
